properties.name: suez_canal_core
properties.description: Suez Canal event AOI: the southern single-lane section of the canal, its Suez entrance and the Ever Given grounding site (approx. 30.02 N, 32.58 E, canal km 151).
properties.navigation_rationale: Single-lane canal section with no passing possibility; a blockage here stops the whole convoy. Chosen from the navigation chart, not from matching-rate results.
properties.caveat: The box contains desert on both banks, so the areal coverage fraction is dominated by land. Water-only density normalisation is a Phase 4B refinement.
